{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America celebrates the two Supreme Court rulings on marriage equality as a major step in the unending struggle for equal rights for the LGBTQ community.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Most Americans now accept marriage equality, according to the Supreme Court.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court’s decision will enable married same-sex couples to access federal benefits.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court strikes down Proposition 8’s ban on same-sex marriage in California.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court rulings do not end the struggle for equal marital rights for the LGBTQ community.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court referenced the Fifth Amendment’s guarantee of “equal protection” and “due process before the law” in both decisions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court failed to establish a federal right to same-sex marriage by holding state bans on same-sex marriage as unconstitutional.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court did not explicitly state that recalcitrant states must recognize, under the “full faith and credit” clause of the Constitution, the legally married status of LGBT couples married in other states.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Whether same-sex couples married in one state, but residing in a state without same-sex marriage, could access all federal benefits could be affected.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"LGBT couples married in one state, but resident in one in which same-sex marriage does not exist, might still be denied the legal rights of a spouse, such as to hospital visitation, legal power of attorney, inheritance, and child custody.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
